title: Total doctors

title: Monthly appointment trend
question: How does appointment volume change by month?

title: Appointments by department
question: Which departments handle the most appointments?
explanation: Keeps every department visible even when it has no matching appointment.

title: Recent appointments
question: What are the most recent appointments and who handled them?

title: Department performance
question: How do departments compare on workload, no-shows, and revenue?

title: Doctor workload
question: How many appointments and unique patients does each doctor handle?

title: Patient activity

explanation: Keeps registered patients in the result even when they have no appointments.

title: Patient visit history
question: What appointments, doctors, treatments, and payments belong to a patient?

title: Outstanding treatments
question: Which treatments are pending or only partially paid?

title: Patients without appointments
question: Which registered patients have never booked an appointment?
